Subject: MedGrid security qualification: IR & BCP evidence and next steps

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so your security team can start intake: 

Summary from our side
- Redwood provides hosted inference and private deployment options; during the demo we discussed both Hosted API and Private VPC.
- Primary security lenses: SOC 2 status, data residency and retention for PHI, and your incident notification SLA expectations.

Immediate asks we agreed to capture
1) SOC 2 evidence: current status (Type I/Type II), date of last audit, and auditor name. We can provide our SOC 2 summary and control matrix.
2) Incident response timeline: sample notification windows you expect (detection -> customer notification). Please confirm whether a 24-hour customer notification is required or if different tiers apply for PII/PHI.
3) BCP / DR documentation: high-level runbook or RTO/RPO targets, recovery run cadence, and contact points for an IR escalation.
4) Vendor security questionnaire: we’ll kick off with the spreadsheet you shared; if you prefer, we can start by answering the SOC/IR/BCP sections first to speed review.

Attached for your intake team: redwood_soc2_snapshot.pdf (high-level), redwood_ir_playbook.pdf (executive summary), redwood_bcp_summary.xlsx (high-level RTO/RPO). I’ve also added a HubSpot link to the deal for traceability below.

Next steps
- You: confirm primary security contact(s) and any immediate deadlines for procurement or legal.
- We (Ben + Monica): prepare a short control matrix and a one-page IR notification template mapping to the timelines you request.

I’ve cc’d Ben and Monica to own the follow-ups and drop the artifacts into the Drive folder. If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min intake call with your security team this week.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the clear recap. I work with Arjun on vendor security intake; looping him in so he can drive the questionnaire. A few notes from our side: 

- SOC 2: we require a Type II report for production vendors where PHI is involved. If you have a current Type II, please share the report or an authorized SOC 2 letter (redacted OK). If you only have Type I, we can discuss compensating controls and a timeline requirement for Type II.
- GDPR/HIPAA: we will need your DPA and details on how PHI is segregated in the hosted option vs private VPC.
- Incident notification: our policy requires initial customer notification within 24 hours of confirmed breach affecting PHI, with hourly status updates until containment. Please confirm your ability to meet that SLA for hosted customers and any differences for Private deployments.

Action items on our side
- I’ll open a vendor intake ticket and send you the baseline questionnaire (Procurement will then add contract redlines).
- Arjun will reach out to request any clarifications on control mappings.

Thanks — we’d like the SOC/IR artifacts in the ticket by EOD Wednesday (24 Nov) if possible.

Claire Watson
Director of Security & Compliance | MedGrid Health
claire.watson@medgrid.health

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the attachments. A few clarifying questions before we file the vendor ticket:

1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm whether the attached SOC snapshot corresponds to a completed Type II? If not, please provide the latest auditor name and expected Type II completion window.
2) IR contact matrix: who are your 24/7 escalation contacts? Please include name, role, phone, and PGP or alternative secure channel if available.
3) Breach notification windows: do you have a documented timeline (detection -> internal escalation -> customer notification -> public disclosure) with target times? An example template is helpful.
4) BCP/DR evidence: we require one of the following: (a) a DR run result for the past 12 months, (b) a third-party attestation, or (c) an internally signed RTO/RPO summary. 

For our timeline: we’ll open the intake ticket today and aim to complete initial review by Friday, 26 Nov, provided we get the SOC/IR artifacts by EOD Wednesday.

Regards,
